scope: HOY Gastro La Manga del Mar Menor versus observed Region 1 discovery/menu/distribution surfaces

menu_breadth.response: Close source-backed structured-menu gap; prioritize first-party candidates and block third-party copying.

cross_restaurant_food_search.current_position: implemented as Food Finder 2.50 on guest-approved native menus
cross_restaurant_food_search.constraint: Value scales with native menu coverage.

truth_and_provenance.response: Keep first-party/source authority, freshness and fail-closed publication as product features, not back-office metadata.

family_and_accessibility.current_position: deeper structured model than generic category/service badges
family_and_accessibility.response: Increase verified coverage without collapsing unknown into yes/no claims.

attention_and_seo.response: Build source-backed indexable decision pages and a distribution plan; do not rely on app quality alone.

merchant_distribution.response: Use free claim/correction path, menu-control value, events/promotions and local partnerships to create merchant pull.

multi_vertical_platform.current_position: potential HOY advantage, not yet market-proven
multi_vertical_platform.response: Exploit shared truth/merchant/data infrastructure across Gastro and Lifestyle only where G2 proof or exit value improves.

priority_gaps.reason: Food Finder and price utility are coverage-constrained and Tu Localidad advertises materially broader menu supply.
Viviendo and editorial/Activa channels already aggregate local demand and merchants.
Menu freshness, NOW, events and promotions require an operator update channel that is easier than updating multiple directories.
The Viviendo/Activa blindspots show that competitor discovery must be an operating process, not an ad-hoc audit.

market_proof_signals.source: El Paladar de la Huerta / referenced comparator
market_proof_signals.hoy_use: external demand signal only; not HOY analytics
